verdict_text:
NO

The script drops head index 6 (DROP_HEAD = 6), but the specification requires removing head 5. This violates the "Required result" section's opening instruction ("For every layer `i`, remove head 5") and consequently produces wrong row/column keep-ranges (it keeps rows/cols corresponding to skipping block 6, not block 5), so the output values will not match the required slices (`0..3839,4608..6143` for rows, `0..1279,1536..2047` for columns) even though the resulting shapes happen to be correct.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
